controls.label: Completed shape model
controls.description: Completed PDS shape model: measured terrain covers about half the nucleus; the unseen side uses the archive’s fitted ellipsoid and joining faces. The smooth far side is estimated, not observed terrain. Neutral gray is a model material, not albedo. Orientation is fixed at an arbitrary phase.
